title: Jmancurly
requirements: Production of a comprehensive visual wearable portfolio representing a prominent YouTube creator's digital brand. The assets covered distinct character heads, signature custom hairstyles, branded jackets, custom phone accessories, and secondary retro blocky variants. Every component required optimization to pass Roblox's marketplace validators while retaining dense, detailed organic hair shapes.
achievements: Converted intricate trademark branding graphics into sub-3,000 polygon wearable accessories
Preserved high-detail visual weight in complex curly hair curves through intelligent retopology
Assembled a unified multi-avatar release catalog spanning diverse geometry styles
